title: CROWD RACING
summary: A racing identity built for speed and driven by competition, with one geometric mark that carries a C, a hidden R and a runner in motion.
body:
CROWD RACING is a motorsport brand that needed an identity with the same energy, intensity and competitive edge as the sport itself.

The brief came down to four words: speed, strength, movement and precision. The identity had to feel fast at a glance and stay strong and recognisable wherever it appears, from a helmet visor to a trackside screen.

The symbol brings three ideas together. The letter C opens the name CROWD, the letter R is drawn in the negative space inside it, and an abstract runner gives the whole mark a sense of direction and forward motion. Sharp angles and a continuous flow keep it moving while it stays solid. A bold, italic wordmark leans forward with it.

The palette pairs Jester Red, for adrenaline and passion, with Banana Propaganda, a bright yellow that stays visible in fast, crowded racing scenes. Saving Light, a deep burgundy, gives the system its depth, Bats Cloak black adds contrast, and Fantasy off-white and Apricotta warm the palette and give it room to breathe. Lama Sans, in condensed italic weights for headings, keeps the type as fast as the mark.

The identity runs from helmets, cockpits and race wheels to cycling imagery, business cards, a branded event stage and racing gear, all under one line: built for speed, driven by competition.
